note.en: Editorial summary, not an official comparison - no single authority compares IB with NCEA. Each cell is drawn from the two verified data sets in this repo (IB: frontend/src/data/*.json; NCEA: this directory). Written to be neutral: it must not tell a family which to choose.
note.zh: 这是编辑性归纳，不是官方对比——没有任何权威机构出具 IB 与 NCEA 的对照。每一格都取自本仓库已核实的两套数据（IB：frontend/src/data/*.json；NCEA：本目录）。行文保持中立，不替家庭下判断。

ib.en: Six subjects, 3-4 at Higher Level, plus TOK, the Extended Essay and CAS.
ib.zh: 6 门课，其中 3–4 门 HL，外加 TOK、EE 与 CAS。

ncea.en: Credit accumulation: 60 credits at the level or above, plus a separate 20-credit literacy/numeracy co-requisite.
ncea.zh: 学分累积：该级或以上 60 学分，外加独立的 20 学分读写/算术 co-requisite。

ib.en: 1-7 per subject, 45 points maximum, 24 to pass, with published failing conditions.
ib.zh: 每门 1–7 分，满分 45、及格 24，并有公布的失败条件。

ncea.en: Per standard: Not Achieved / Achieved / Merit / Excellence. No overall score; endorsements recognise Merit and Excellence.
ncea.zh: 按标准评：Not Achieved / Achieved / Merit / Excellence。没有总分；用背书体现 Merit 与 Excellence。

ib.en: Fixed shape - one subject from each group, changes are hard once the programme starts.
ib.zh: 结构固定——每组各一门，开课后调整困难。

ncea.en: Mix and match standards across subjects; credits can be built up across years.
ncea.zh: 可跨科目组合标准，学分可跨年累积。

ib.en: Full diploma with at least 24 points, plus literacy and numeracy if studying in New Zealand.
ib.zh: 完整文凭 + 至少 24 分；在新西兰境内就读另需满足读写与算术。

ncea.en: Four parts, all required: NCEA Level 3; 14 Level 3 credits in each of 3 approved subjects; 10 literacy credits at Level 2+; 10 numeracy credits at Level 1+.
ncea.zh: 四项缺一不可：取得 NCEA Level 3；三门认可科目各 14 个 Level 3 学分；Level 2+ 读写 10 学分；Level 1+ 算术 10 学分。

ib.en: Subjects are revised on published cycles, but the diploma's shape is unchanged.
ib.zh: 科目按公布的周期改版，但文凭的整体结构不变。

ncea.en: Being replaced in stages from 2028 by a Foundational Award, NZCE and NZACE. The design is still being finalised.
ncea.zh: 自 2028 年起被 Foundational Award、NZCE、NZACE 分阶段取代，设计仍在最终确定中。

ib.en: Designed as an international qualification and widely recognised by universities abroad.
ib.zh: 本身就是国际资格，海外大学广泛认可。

ncea.en: A New Zealand national qualification; NZQA publishes guidance on using it to apply overseas.
ncea.zh: 新西兰本国学历；NZQA 有专门指引说明如何用它申请海外院校。
